transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Well, I came in because I just keep steering clear of my own workshop. And, uh, any family get-together where my brother-in-law might be, I just don't go to those either. I guess after all this time... I'm just tired of planning my whole life around making sure I don't run into those reminders. It's getting to be too much.
What specific event or experience are these places and people reminding you of?
I, uh... I don't really want to get into the details of it. It's just something that happened a while back involving my brother-in-law and the workshop. That's all I'm comfortable saying right now.
Without going into the details, do unwanted memories or images of what happened ever pop into your mind against your will?

Yeah, they do. Out of nowhere, I'll just... I'll see his hand with that heavy tool again. It's like a picture that just pops right into my head when I'm doing something completely normal, like when I'm shaving in the morning or just working on a painting. And whenever it happens, it still makes my chest tighten up.
At the time this happened, did you feel your life was in danger or that you were going to be seriously hurt?

I'm not really sure. I mean... when it was happening, I didn't exactly stop to think if my life was on the line. I just saw him with that heavy tool and... well, I just knew I was in a bad spot. But as far as thinking I was going to die or be seriously hurt right at that exact second... I don't really know. I didn't have time to process it like that, it all just happened.
Since that happened, do you find yourself constantly on guard or watching out for danger, even in safe places?

Yeah, I do. Even in places that are perfectly safe, like over at the senior center or down in the church basement, I find myself doing it. I'll be sitting there and... well, I'm always checking to see who just came in. I make sure I know exactly where the door is at all times. And I'm always looking over my shoulder to see if anyone is standing too close behind me. It's just a habit I can't seem to shake now, I always feel like I need to know exactly what's going on around me.
